map.初速度位移与匀加速位移之和。: The sum of initial-velocity displacement and uniformly-accelerated displacement.

map.x=v₀t+½at²=4×6+½×3×6²=24+54=78.000 m。若物体: x=v₀t+½at²=4×6+½×3×6²=24+54=78.000 m. If the object starts from rest (v₀=0), it reduces to the familiar x=½at².
map.匀加速时平均速 = (v₀+v)/2，位移 = v̄×t，与该式等价；非匀加速不: Under uniform acceleration average speed = (v₀+v)/2, displacement = v̄×t, equivalent to this formula; not valid for non-uniform acceleration.

map.已知时间用本页的 x=v₀t+½at²；不知道时间但已知末速度时，改用 v²=v: Use this page's x=v₀t+½at² when time is known; when time is unknown but final velocity is known, use v²=v₀²+2ax instead (see the "Velocity-Displacement" tool). They are equivalent, differing only in known conditions.
